values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Federal Energy Regulatory Commission order from May 2020 approved a lease that lets Sabine Pipe Line move 300,000 Dth per day of firm capacity on Bridgeline's intrastate system in southern Louisiana. The order says the lease lets Sabine serve Venture Global Calcasieu Pass, which needs the gas as feedstock for its LNG export terminal.

verifications.note: A FERC order issued May 21, 2020 (dockets CP20-24 and CP20-25). It names Bridgeline's intrastate system in southern Louisiana and says the leased capacity serves Venture Global Calcasieu Pass, the LNG export terminal on the Calcasieu Ship Channel.

records.researcher_notes: The tie rests on a 2020 FERC order about a capacity lease. The order does not say whether the lease is still in use today, so a later check is worth doing. No second source was taken.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An Enerdata report on the completed Atlantic Sunrise expansion says the project connects Marcellus gas with markets that include the Cove Point LNG export facility in Maryland.

verifications.note: An Enerdata news item on Williams completing the US$3bn Atlantic Sunrise expansion. It says the project connects Marcellus gas with markets in the Mid-Atlantic, including the Cove Point LNG export facility.

records.researcher_notes: Cove Point is listed as export and import in the terminal file. The tie here is one market named among several, so the tier is medium. The report is a trade news summary, not the project's own filing.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A May 2026 Canada Gazette order for Westcoast's Sunrise expansion says the T-South system already has firm contracts to deliver gas to Woodfibre LNG, a liquefied natural gas export plant in British Columbia expected in service in 2027. The order says deliveries to that plant will need added capacity on the same system.

verifications.note: Canada Gazette Part I, May 2, 2026, Order in Council directing a certificate for the Sunrise Expansion Program. It names Westcoast Energy and its T-South system, and says Westcoast has firm-service contracts to supply Woodfibre LNG.

records.researcher_notes: Woodfibre is a Canadian export plant, so the US export flag stays blank. The terminal name is recorded because the pipeline is tied to it. The row's segment is Westcoast Pipeline, and the order describes the existing T-South system that serves it.
